description: This Dart source file defines a TaskProvider class that manages task data, handles CRUD operations, filtering, and persistence for a to-do list application using Flutter and shared preferences.

classes.name: TaskProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier class that manages task list state, CRUD operations, filtering, and persistent filter settings for a task management app.

classes.name: TaskFilter
classes.description: An enum representing the filtering options for tasks: all, pending, and completed.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the provider by restoring the filter setting and loading tasks.

methods.name: loadTasks
methods.description: Loads all tasks from the repository.

methods.name: addTask
methods.description: Creates and adds a new task with the given title.

methods.name: editTask
methods.description: Updates the title of an existing task.

methods.name: toggleCompleted
methods.description: Toggles the completion status of a task.

methods.name: setFilter
methods.description: Sets and persists the current filter for displaying tasks.

methods.name: _applyFilter
methods.description: Returns the list of tasks filtered based on the current filter setting.

methods.name: _restoreFilter
methods.description: Restores the task filter from persistent storage.
